title: The cast, first round: nine personas, their moods and their cards
headline: The designer has drawn the first round of the cast (LAB 27): the nine as personas, each with something on its head and something in its hand; four moods each; a Top-Trumps-style card each, with values from the register only, no invented ratings; and an 'on stage now' marker that lights each member from its first commit. A first proposal: the personalities come next from the storyteller.

people drawn: you are not, until you say

for_you.ask: First reaction to the nine (PDF attached)

for_you.detail: The designer has left you undrawn: the narrator's voice without a figure. A figure of you would be a likeness of a real person, so only with your go.
